report_name: Ripon and Catterick and Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plans
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to validate desire lines, identify important routes, and model potential increases in cycling under different scenarios.
other_tools_developed: A prioritisation framework was developed using 14 criteria across categories of Effectiveness, Policy Alignment, Economic factors, and Deliverability to score and rank schemes.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP process has identified priority schemes for Ripon and Catterick to attract funding opportunities, and has informed the development of draft designs for priority corridors, with £69,962 spent on development funded through the Transport Planning budget and s106 funds.
pct_usage_quote: The route along Clotherholme Road and Park Street is the most popular route in all current and future scenarios in the Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT)
